title: Reject Kafka in favour of a simple message queue
decision_statement: Use an in-process job queue (e.g. Redis Streams) instead of Kafka for the Alpha service bus.
context_summary: Alpha has two internal consumers, moderate traffic, no replay requirement, and a small ops team with no Kafka experience.

assumptions.statement: Consumer count will remain low (<5) for the foreseeable future.
Ops team will not grow significantly in the next 12 months.

alternatives.reason: Operational overhead too high for two consumers and no replay need.
Low ops burden, sufficient throughput for moderate traffic.
Adequate but team unfamiliar; not justified over Redis for MVP.

reasons.statement: Kafka's partition/broker model is over-engineered for two consumers at moderate traffic.
No replay requirement removes Kafka's primary differentiating value.
Small ops team lacks Kafka expertise; operational risk outweighs messaging benefits.
